profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack & Platform Engineering | SRE | AWS EKS | TypeScript | React | Generative AI | Production Reliability
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building, modernizing, and operating production software systems across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and AI-powered applications.
At vCreative I combine software engineering with site reliability responsibilities. I own production AWS environments (Amazon EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM) and focus on performance, availability, and operational efficiency.
Key results include:
• Modernizing a legacy operations platform serving ~5,000 daily users — reduced average response time from 1,000 ms to 150 ms (85% improvement) while supporting ~100,000 requests per hour
• Eliminating load- and traffic-spike-related downtime incidents that previously accounted for up to 80% of reported platform issues
• Maintaining a 95% Service Level Expectation over a full year for critical order-intake and automated-processing workflows
• Shipping generative AI features: semantic search and LLM-powered self-service reporting (using MCP, Apache Superset, and dbt)
• Running controlled A/B tests via Kubernetes ingress and separate deployments, measuring order-entry time and user-reported incidents
My technical toolkit includes React, TypeScript/JavaScript, REST APIs, microservices, AWS, Kubernetes, and practical applications of large language models.
I hold graduate degrees in Data Science and Cybersecurity.
I’m particularly interested in large-scale customer-facing platforms, distributed systems, cloud reliability, and the thoughtful integration of generative AI into production software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernized and refactored a legacy operations platform serving ~5,000 daily users, reducing average response time
from 1,000 ms to 150 ms (85% improvement) while supporting ~100,000 requests per hour.
• Eliminated observed load- and traffic-spike-related downtime incidents that previously accounted for up to 80% of
reported platform issues, significantly improving production reliability under peak usage.
• Maintained a 95% Service Level Expectation (SLE) over a full 12-month period for critical order-intake and
automated-processing workflows through infrastructure optimization, performance tuning, and sustained reliability
engineering.
• Owned production AWS platform infrastructure including Amazon EKS environments, S3 cost management, AWS
Lambda, and IAM. Supported a microservices architecture spanning REST APIs, message queues, scheduled jobs
(crons), and multiple technology stacks.
• Built and deployed generative AI capabilities: semantic search to enhance information retrieval, and AI-powered self-
service report generation using large language models (LLMs) and Model Context Protocol (MCP), integrated with
Apache Superset and dbt for the reporting and data pipeline.
• Designed and ran controlled A/B tests for higher-risk changes and exploratory experiments using Kubernetes ingress
and separate deployments. Measured order-entry time and user-reported incident data to evaluate operational impact
and validate improvements.
• Delivered full-stack features and production backend services, translating business and operational
requirements into maintainable software while balancing customer-facing functionality with performance, availability,
and operational excellence

• Manage Linux Servers running Ubuntu for Ftp and Mysql
• Develop web applications in ASP.NET, C#, JSP for basic sales reports
• Technical Support to Corporates

• Manage the Asa Firewalls of every Store

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
In this position i was in charge to develop requirements and functionalitys in their totallity, starting from de Design of the html , jquery and javascript code to handle the events, and develop the restful api's to manage the business logic and database connections, also in the last year i've gained complete experience with the MVC architecture using angular.js with java restful services with json or xml responses.The restfull services were all in different languages and platforms, but the bigger projects were developed in JSP and .NET Framework using C# and Vb.

The bigger project i worked with was a Banking Web Application for Fedecredito Bank in El Salvador, in that project the architecture required high complexity design since they allready had a legacy system for bank accounts and transactions, so we solved that using a middleware system that we called xtreme that took all the transactions asked by our web application and xtreme was in charge to communicate with their banking system, this was all handled really carefully using ssl certificates and encryption to apply pci standards.

Like Mentioned before I was responsible of develop the totatilly of the requirements asked by our customers, this included the manipulation of Data (DDL,DML & TSQL) with full interaction with the Dbms, usually we worked on MS SQL Server but a year ago i was in charge to deploy a high availabilty Oracle 11g server using dataguard and tcp controllers, and also some small projects used informix and db2 databases.

Is convenient to mention that the last two projects i worked with were fully responsive one using bootstrap and the other one using jquery UI with foundation css. Also I was in charge to deploy and audit Linux Servers, using Tomcat and GlassFish for the small JSP projects.
